module.core: Shop back office on the web, on phone or computer; set up the shop, branches and staff yourself
module.crm: Appointment calendar, bookings, rescheduling, customer records with visit history, and a service list with prices
module.messaging: Connect the shop's LINE OA; booking confirmations and reminders are sent to customers automatically
module.booking: A link and QR code for customers to book online themselves, showing only truly free times; set how far ahead they can book and the cancellation cut-off
module.checkout: Take payments, issue bills and receipts, take deposits; customers attach a slip and the shop checks and confirms it
module.payouts: Staff hand fees calculated automatically; see what the practitioner gets and what the shop keeps per service
module.inventory: Products and stock, retail sales at the counter, stock counts
module.checklists: Daily task checklists, opening and closing
module.approvals: Approval inbox, e.g. discounts or voided bills need a manager's approval
module.clinical: Treatment records and treatment plans for clinics (added automatically to clinic-type shops on Premium and up; not on Basic)
module.expenses: Record expenses and other income; income, expenses and net profit by month and year (Business package and above)
module.branch_insights: Branch comparison, nightly summary, unusual-activity alerts, PIN approval, goals, ratings per branch (Enterprise package)
module.lite: A simple app with a short menu, ready to use; the shop's LINE OA can be connected later
